title: Khambhat (5) Foreign ships
text:
13. Khambhat (5) Foreign ships

bringing cargo
for transhipment
in daughter
ships.

(6) Daughter ships in

ballast being
loaded with
cargo from
tankers and
leaving for ports
other than
Gujarat State
ports.

Re. 0.60 p. per ton. Twice in a year _i.e. to_
say once between the
1st January to the 30th
June and once between
the 1st July to the 31st
December.

Re. 1.00 p. per ton. -do
